725:t_003:12.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Silence, Earth brat. We are beings who have mastered the truth of the universe!」

725:t_003:14.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「To bring that enemy down, we do not mind joining hands.」

725:t_003:15.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Then, Father... Is it not possible for you to cooperate with us as well?」

725:t_003:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「What we must do now is defeat the $$御使い$$s and stop the great collapse of the universe that is still going on.」

725:t_003:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「To do that, we too must first stop fighting and join hands.」

725:t_003:18.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! How hopelessly foolish you are!」

725:t_003:19.en:
$$ズール$$
「We joined hands because we recognized each other's power.」

725:t_003:20.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That a species that has barely reached the entrance of $$シンカ$$ would think itself our equal... it makes me laugh.」

725:t_003:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...So you're no different from the $$御使い$$s.」

725:t_003:22.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Don't make me laugh! Is your 'truth of living together' just villains teaming up with villains?!」

725:t_003:23.en:
$$タケル$$
(They really do resemble the $$御使い$$s... And the source of their power is...)

725:t_003:24.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「But do not worry. In place of the $$御使い$$s, we will manage every universe.」

725:t_003:25.en:
$$ズール$$
「We will stop the great collapse of the universe as well.」

725:t_003:26.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You who bear a fragment of $$太極$$. We shall put you to use as our forces.」

725:t_003:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「Look at me, moving up in the world. Getting scouted by the boss of the evil gods, no less.」

725:t_003:28.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then I'll answer for all the Reactors.」

725:t_003:29.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No matter how much money you pile up, the answer is no!」

725:t_003:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「It couldn't be a more complete rejection.」

725:t_003:31.en:
$$ズール$$
「Fools. You throw away the chance to gain eternity with your own hands?」

725:t_003:32.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「In the end, these fellows are a foolish species that cannot complete their $$シンカ$$... They are merely human.」

725:t_003:33.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Father... You people... have no right to live in this universe...」

725:t_003:34.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「What did you say, $$グーラ$$?」

725:t_003:35.en:
$$刹那$$
「What this universe needs is a heart that accepts others and walks together with them!」

725:t_003:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「We don't need rulers like you or the $$御使い$$s!」

725:t_003:37.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I once said you were gods, but evil gods at that. Allow me to correct that here.」

725:t_003:38.en:
$$シモン$$
「Using a word like 'god' for scum like you is a waste!」

725:t_003:39.en:
$$万丈$$
「You are nothing but common villains!」

725:t_003:40.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Howl all you like, inferior species!」

725:t_003:41.en:
$$ズール$$
「Do not think you can beat us just because you have gained a little power.」

725:t_003:42.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「We shall show you that our dark power has grown stronger in this universe as well!」

725:t_003:43.en:
$$タケル$$
「No more words are needed! We settle this here, you rulers of darkness!」

725:t_003:45.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Yes...! I... we have to fight that giant evil in order to live!」

725:t_003:46.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's do it! We'll defeat you and advance to $$エス・テラン$$!」

725:t_003:47.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Then I'll show you! The power of the gods!」

725:t_003:48.en:
$$ズール$$
「And in the darkness, regret your own powerlessness!」

725:t_003:49.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「The powerless die! Learn with your own bodies the law of the universe, which surpasses even its truth!」

725:t_004:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You're putting up quite a fight.」

725:t_004:1.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「As one would expect from those who beat us once and even set foot in $$シンカ$$.」

725:t_004:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Even knowing that, why are you so confident!?」

725:t_004:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Do you want to know, $$ゼウス$$?」

725:t_004:4.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「The reason is that they have not fully shed their humanity.」

725:t_004:5.en:
$$ズール$$
「The darkness deep within them will devour them from the inside...!」

725:t_004:7.en:
$$ズール$$
「Now... fall! Into the world of darkness!」

725:t_006:1.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You are a god. You cannot understand.」

725:t_006:2.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Humans are weak creatures... Within their hearts, regret over the past and anxiety about the future always swirl.」

725:t_006:3.en:
$$ズール$$
「At times it even drives them to try to erase their own existence.」

725:t_006:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Surely so! Humans always carry within their hearts the force that seeks to vanish!」

725:t_006:6.en:
$$ズール$$
「Beings who create the power of life, yet are seized by the force that seeks to vanish... the power of darkness...! That is what humans are!」

725:t_006:7.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Creatures like that cannot possibly live on in this universe!」

725:t_006:8.en:
$n
「I've been listening this whole time, and you just keep rambling on however you please...!」

725:t_006:10.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Why are you not swallowed by your own despair!」

725:t_006:11.en:
$n
「Guys like you have hit me with that kind of attack plenty of times already...! I'm not going to keep taking it forever!」

725:t_006:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「It may be true that humans are creatures who carry darkness in their hearts, as you say...」

725:t_006:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「I lost my brother, and I live carrying that sadness and regret...! But that gives me strength!」

725:t_006:15.en:
$n
「The despair and anxiety in our hearts are part of what makes us who we are now!」

725:t_006:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「We will go on living, shouldering both light and darkness!」

725:t_007:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That was close. Thanks to that needless interference, I almost got crushed by regret.」

725:t_007:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「No matter how much regret or anxiety we have, we will keep on living!」

725:t_007:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Denying the past is meaningless. It can no longer be changed.」

725:t_007:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's why we live! To make the future better!」

725:t_007:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$タケル$$! Your words woke me up!」

725:t_007:5.en:
$$葵$$
「It's $$マーグ$$'s presence that gives $$タケル$$ strength, isn't it?」

725:t_007:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「We'll follow too! We won't deny the darkness inside us, we'll overcome it!」

725:t_007:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「In your case, you were merely repaid for the favors you've done us so far.」

725:t_007:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Besides, the only reason you got past hope and despair is because we helped you!」

725:t_007:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Give it up, $n! Bragging about your achievements makes a man look small!」

725:t_007:14.en:
$$シン$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is way too soft on $n.」

uncertain: 725:t_003:23: Takeru's thought has no stated comparand; read as the gods resembling the $$御使い$$s (Zero's line just before says they are the same as them).
725:t_006:13: Xul's 'マーズ！' read as him reacting to Takeru's brother Mars ($$マーズ$$, proposed token) appearing.
725:t_007:8: Sousuke's 貸しを返してもらった read as Hibiki being repaid for favors he did the others earlier.
$$シンカ$$ used as a noun token for 真化; 真化しきれない = 'cannot complete their $$シンカ$$'.
725:t_003:49: 宇宙の理 rendered 'law of the universe' (vs 真理 'truth').
$$太極$$ and $$エス・テラン$$ used as tokens (keyword entries); $$マーズ$$ is 'proposed' in glossary.
